connector.name: Ryvo Protocol
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Ryvo Protocol state reads and prepare-only payment-channel actions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package protocol-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ryvonetwork account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RYVO_PROTOCOL_PROGRAM_ID

env.name: RYVO_PROTOCOL_DEVNET_USDC_TOKEN_ID
env.description: Official devnet USDC token ID in the deployed Ryvo token registry.
